newsitem.title: UK: European cotton enquiry kickstarted by New York.
newsitem.headline: European cotton enquiry kickstarted by New York.

text.p: Softer New York futures kicked Europe's raw cotton markets back into life on Wednesday, market sources said.
"U.S cottons now appear competitively priced compared with Central African and Asian growths," one industry expert said.
U.S. Middling 1-1/32 inches were quoted down by 0.75-1.00 cents a lb, with Memphis styles selling at around 81.75 cents.
The sudden addition of extra competition forced sellers of upland growths to reassess their asking prices which brought a flurry of price-testing, trade sources said.
But, the strong U.S. dollar is limiting the amount of fresh business and trade has been focussed on nearby requirements, they added. London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
